title: MC 402: Natural Ventilation
officialText:
402.1 General.

Natural ventilation of occupiable and habitable spaces shall comply with Chapter 12 of the New York City Building Code.

402.2 Reserved.

402.3 Reserved.

402.4 Reserved.
